{"consolidated_memory":"Route shadowing in api/gateway/router.go: Four separate incidents with identical symptom and repro (curl two overlapping prefixes in order, wrong handler name appears in request span), but different root causes and contexts:

**Occasion 1: [2026-01-21]**
- Context: Staging read replica only
- Root cause: Off-by-one in slice bound
- Fix: Corrected the bound; added property test
- PR #5470, branch fix/route-shadowing-1
- Result: Job time reduced from 5 hours to 57 minutes
- Test coverage: api/gateway/router_test.go

**Occasion 2: [2026-02-11]**
- Context: Clients pinned to v1 SDK only
- Root cause: Unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: Capped retry attempts; added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR #6889, branch fix/route-shadowing-2
- Result: Alert stayed quiet for 31 consecutive days
- Test coverage: api/gateway/router_test.go

**Occasion 3: [2026-02-17]**
- Context: After client had already retried once
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind lazy relation
- Fix: Prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR #9159, branch fix/route-shadowing-3
- Result: Memory settled at 352 MB instead of climbing past 2 GB
- Test coverage: api/gateway/router_test.go

**Occasion 4: [2026-08-31]**
- Context: After rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: Naive datetime compared against aware datetime
- Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR #9416, branch fix/route-shadowing-4
- Result: Throughput rose 24% to 693 requests per second
- Test coverage: api/gateway/router_test.go

All work in Go. Same file, same symptom, different triggers and fixes."}
